name: PORTFOLIO_SERVER_TRACEMALLOC_REPLAY_20261107
comment: ANCHOR: PORTFOLIO_SERVER_TRACEMALLOC_REPLAY_20261107 — LQ-20261107-229. The live portfolio-server grew
1.13 -> 1.59 GB RSS during one walk of the /v3 pages. scripts/ops/portfolio_server_tracemalloc_replay.py
replays the walk against a second instance in a bwrap sandbox (read-only root, copy-on-write HOME,
no network, credentials masked, read-only DB session) and ranks tracemalloc growth per pass.
The tests pin the ranking (frames run oldest -> newest), the sandbox argv (only the report dir and
the DB socket dir are writable), the env (built, never inherited; no secret-shaped key) and the dry run.
Registered because a new pytest file that no gate names is not run by CI (check_test_coverage --fail-on-new).
